from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of the equity data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    equity_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written (e.g., 'Total Stockholders' Deficit', 'Total net assets')")
    equity_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric equity value reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount as written (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_equity_records: list[CompanyEquityRecord]
